title: DataQ Top-20 change register (2026-11-23, evidence-verified)
verification_notes: Search broken: pagefind imported at '/pagefind/pagefind.js' (root-absolute) -> https://deepmindq.github.io/pagefind/pagefind.js returns 404; typing 'data analytics' on live /search/ returned 0 results.

Forms dead: bundle chunks contain 'process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FORM_ACCESS_KEY' unresolved and the fetch is guarded by truthiness of the key; only .env.example exists -> access_key undefined at export time -> Contact + Newsletter submissions cannot deliver.

Domain split-brain: canonical/og:url/sitemap.xml/robots.txt all point to https://www.dataqsoft.com which serves an interstitial ('One moment, please...'); real content lives on deepmindq.github.io/DataQ.
OG images: single public/og-default.png used site-wide; og:image host is the broken domain.
Analytics: CookieConsent offers 'Accept analytics' but no analytics loader exists anywhere (gtag/plausible/posthog absent).
Social: SiteFooter.tsx line 128 LinkedIn href='#'; social-linkedin.png / social-x.png assets exist unused.
Images: 29 files in public/images for 727 pages; HomeView/DataVisuals contain zero alt attributes (SVG-based, decorative).
Sitemap: lastmod = build timestamp for all URLs; changeFrequency monthly.
Deploy: manual scripts/deploy_gh.sh with /tmp/.ghtoken; no .github/workflows CI. Token missing after sandbox reset.
404 status correct on Pages; page <title> falls back to site-default meta.
Search UX: pagefind index exists in out (npx pagefind --site out runs in export script).

2026-11-23 follow-up: sandbox reset wiped site/node_modules (npm ci restored) and out-gh (re-exported, 733 pages). Homepage slimming landed via mega-panel lazy mount; Lighthouse caught + fixed basePath 404s on manifest/icons, list nesting, 4 contrast nodes, 1 target-size; all verified runtime (search 20 results, form mailto fallback, mega menu mount/switch/Esc).
